context.purpose: Construct one bounded solid from declared primitives, profiles and solid operations; publish an editable FCStd model with STEP and tessellated STL. Finishing can express geometric edge intent with exact match cardinality, re-evaluated on each design variant. Optional named geometric measurements publish verified values for downstream adaptors. A bounded designStudy can adjust one length to reach a named geometric target with explicit units and response direction. Optional native length parameters preserve shared affine design intent across features and native reopening. Mechanical parts can use an explicit Body with constrained XY sketches, first Pad and a linear through-all Pocket history.
context.assumptions: Lengths are millimetres. FreeCAD public document and shape APIs execute in an isolated process; literal options and earlier-node references define the supported subset.
context.constraints: The output must be one valid positive-volume solid. Profiles cannot be final outputs. Host-valid booleans can still fail native geometry checks; STL tessellation loses exact surface representation. Design studies are batch-only, change one resolved scalar option, and test a sampled response assumption; they do not solve general CAD constraints. Native parameters are batch-only, with bounded primitive, extrusion, rectangle/circle sketch and Pad length targets; they cannot combine with live editing or designStudy. PartDesign supports one origin-based Body, one first Pad and current-tip Pockets, with same-Body profile ownership; no second Pad, feature branches or mixed Part/PartDesign dependencies. The Body itself is not a solid output. importSTEP needs the assigned file unit, volume plus an orientation-sensitive fact, and one solid within 32 MiB, 100000 entities and 2000 edges per loop; it is batch-only and cannot share a document with a PartDesign Body. Runs without hardened export evidence fail with RERUN_REQUIRED.
context.inspection: Inspect native shape validity, solid count, volume and bounds; verify reopens publications and checks geometry. The embedded box has analytic volume 1000 cubic millimetres. A preview alone does not establish geometry correctness. Native topology inspection supports analytic visit selection. Geometric selection evidence retains source edges, matches and actual native assignments before and after reopening. measurements.json provides selected node quantities with explicit units; value references select artifact 3 and /measurements/ID/value. Live geometry exposes the same requested measurements for its revision. Design studies retain study-summary.json and study.html with every candidate, target band and stop decision. Parameterised documents additionally verify exact typed VarSet membership and all ExpressionEngine assignments in native observations and the saved FCStd. PartDesign additionally verifies ordered Body Group/Tip, Origin roles, placements, sketch constraint types/names/endpoints, profile/base links and true ThroughAll semantics; current-shape equality cannot substitute for feature intent. Every new run publishes exact native volume, area, curved area, bounds and centre; verification integrates the STL on the host (signed volume, closure, centre, bounds) within a stated deflection and float32 budget and the 0.5 percent ceiling, and checks the exported STEP unit.
context.recovery: Correct unknown node references and dimensional constraints before running. If booleans fail native checks, inspect operand placement/intersection and simplify the model. Replan and rerun in a fresh directory; preserve failed evidence. EMPTY_SELECTION, AMBIGUOUS_SELECTION and SELECTION_COUNT_MISMATCH require inspecting the effective source geometry and correcting predicates or intentional match counts; no nearest-edge substitution is performed. STUDY_REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET retains an unmet design report; inspect the bracket, sampled response, native validity and finite limits before changing the goal. For CONFLICTING_BINDING remove the driven literal option; INVALID_PARAMETER/INVALID_BINDING require valid bounds and declared terms; UNOBSERVABLE_BINDING requires a measurable driver range; UNREPRESENTABLE_PARAMETER requires a length that survives native storage. INVALID_BODY_OWNERSHIP/INVALID_BODY_HISTORY require same-Body earlier profiles and a linear current-tip chain; select the final solid feature. UNSUPPORTED_ATTACHMENT requires origin XY sketches with zero offset. UNIT_MISMATCH/UNDECLARED_UNIT require the unit the file assigns; EXPECTATION_FAILED names the declared fact that differs; PREPARATION_CHANGED_GEOMETRY means refine changed the part; RERUN_REQUIRED means rerun the document to obtain hardened export evidence.

Design studies replay every proposal and target decision over independently reverified native candidates; unmet histories cannot publish a chosen design.

context.purpose: Create an editable native fixed assembly with reused parts, component links and declared joints; parts are box/cylinder constructors or verified PartDesign part publications joined at named mounts. Use the assembly document instead of a node graph.
context.assumptions: Millimetre geometry, one grounded component and a bounded fixed-joint tree. Constructor parts use box/cylinder definitions; sourced parts use verified single-Body schemaxis.freecad/1 model.FCStd publications (workflow $artifact index 2) with named mounts. Native FreeCAD assembly APIs and solver compute placements.
context.constraints: Fixed joints only: top/bottom faces for constructor parts, named mounts with parent-side offset and clocking for sourced parts; the two part forms never mix. Sourced assemblies refuse the optional GUI capture stage. No revolute motion, persistent assembly process, live editing or node inspection. Common analytic studies and scheduled workflow resume are supported. Timeout applies to each native stage separately for constructor parts and to the whole run for sourced parts.
context.inspection: Inspect saved assembly components, joints, mounts, embedded source copies and independent reopened placement/geometry evidence. Verify the retained run and compare the solved assembly with the declared fixed-joint constraints; a rendered view alone is insufficient.
context.recovery: INVALID_GROUND requires an existing component ID. Repair joint endpoints or connectivity for structural errors. UNSUPPORTED_SOURCE names a source that is not a verified single-Body part publication; INPUT_CHANGED means the source bytes changed, so rerun the part or the assembly into a fresh directory. Preserve solver logs on native failures and simplify constraints.
